manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R} minus {R} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Burning Inquiry for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Burning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards and discard three cards at random.
Repeat
